title: Bracket matcher with a push and pop store
summary: Opening symbols are pushed onto a store and closing symbols pop it; the readout predicts the closer that matches the top of the store.
core_idea: Push openers, pop on closers, and predict the closer of the top opener.

state.name: dunmore
state.meaning: Store of the openers not yet closed, newest on top.

update.name: step
update.latex: dunmore_t = push(dunmore_(t-1), x_t) if x_t opens, else pop(dunmore_(t-1))
update.plain: dunmore_t = push(dunmore_(t-1), x_t) if x_t opens, else pop(dunmore_(t-1))

learning.description: Nothing is learned; the opener and closer pairs are given.
learning.few_shot_argument: Fixture only: no claim about learning speed is made beyond the toy case.

complexity.constants_notes: A handful of operations per symbol in the toy setting.

sample_efficiency.mechanism: Fixture only: the rule is fixed by hand.

prediction.statement: Predicts the right closer after one example of each pair.

capabilities.prediction: Predicts the legal closer at any depth.

known_relatives.name: not assessed
known_relatives.claimed_difference: Fixture only; no difference is claimed.

falsifiers: The store grows on a closer.

toy_example.python:
import json
store = []
for s in '([':
    store.append(s)
store.pop()
print(json.dumps({'depth': len(store), 'top': store[-1]}))
